A modified copy or third-party distribution is not an official PlazCode release
and must not be presented as endorsed or published by this project.
Existing copyright, license and third-party attribution notices must remain intact.
The software's GPL license and third-party licenses remain in effect; this notice
neither revokes their copying/modification rights nor grants trademark permission.
No claim is made that the name/logo is a registered trademark.

This is an origin/branding notice, not copy protection. Client-side code can be
modified. Update SHA256 verification detects packages differing from the expected
feed hash; it does not prove who authored a derivative or prevent redistribution.
